# Updates2MQTT

> Notify and take action on server updates via MQTT, with HomeAssistant compatibility

Updates2MQTT monitors Docker image and local Git-based builds for updates, publishes update details over MQTT, and integrates with Home Assistant's MQTT Update entities. Start with installation and configuration guidance; use the Home Assistant and troubleshooting pages for integration and operations.


## Start here

- [Updates2MQTT](https://updates2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/index.md): Project overview, capabilities, and quick start
- [Installation](https://updates2mqtt.rhizomatics.org.uk/installation/index.md): Installation and deployment options
